findings.message: crossroads/stall: detail bar 0.63 of Eastward's prop band (22.2 tones, 31.6 shapes a patch against 27.0, 50.36)
findings.fix: add drawn structure in clusters of two or more pixels: parts, joints, wear, texture of the material, small story details (art-style.md, Eastward's level of detail is required)

reviewer.note: Round 3 review at 8c212777 (PR #450), docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md, round 3. XR2-S2 fixed (each stripe's top plane in 3-4 tones with a lit row) and XR2-S4 fixed (the counter top is sawn boards with grain, joints and a dark under-lip row; the 416-texel band is gone). XR2-S1 partly: the board now holds three rows of broken strokes, one row in a second tone, but they are blocky repeated L shapes on a one-tone navy field of 281 texels (#38395a [102,133,116,156]), not words and a price. XR2-S3 not fixed and regressed: all 17 nail heads are one-tone 2x2 #2e2943 squares with no lit texel (dot nails, calibration C1); round 2's nails had a lit texel. village.nail_head sets the lit texel, but finish() -> tidy() removes it as a lone pixel. Bar 0.58 -> 0.63. Fix list: XR3-S1, XR3-S2.
fix_list: XR3-S1: nail heads that keep their lit texel: tidy() strips a lone lit texel, so draw the light as 2 texels (the head's top row, or an L), or pass the nail heads to tidy() as `keep`; check the output bytes, not the painter

XR3-S2: the chalk board as words and a price: broken 1-2 px strokes of varying letter shapes (not repeated L glyphs) in two chalk tones, with a faint chalk haze of the second tone smudged over part of the navy field so it is not one tone over 281 texels
